name: three rf-SQUID annealer qubits in which two loops switch at nearly the same flux
question: Does the hysteron model fitted to a frustrated triangle of rf-SQUID loops give its transitions where two loops reach their thresholds at nearly the same flux?
assumptions: phase theta_i of loop i relative to half a flux quantum, time in units of 1/omega_LC, damping 1/Q = 0.5, as in the census model rfsquid_triangle

unequal barrier parameters beta_i, couplings J_ij > 0 (antiferromagnetic, mutual inductance) and flux offsets d_i of the loops, as fabrication and programmed couplers give; the values are an illustration, not those of a measured device
the flux bias eps is swept slowly compared with the relaxation of the loops, without noise
